provenance: ShakeStir editorial expectations; untested, not source-provided or sensory tasting results
scale: 0 none, 1 very low, 2 low, 3 moderate, 4 high, 5 very high; null unknown

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.name: Margarita
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.rationale: The 1 oz lime exceeds 1/2 oz triple sec; expect a tart, lightly sweet sour, with no bittering ingredient.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1111.name: Blue Margarita
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1111.rationale: 1 oz blue curacao supplies more sweetness than the base Margarita; 1 oz lime still gives high acidity.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1721.name: Tommy's Margarita
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1721.rationale: Two spoons agave syrup balance 1.5 cl lime against 4.5 cl tequila; spoon size and syrup strength vary.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1615.name: Whitecap Margarita
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1615.rationale: A quarter cup cream of coconut is a substantial sweetener against three tablespoons lime; ice dilutes the frozen serve.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1232.name: Strawberry Margarita
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1232.rationale: Strawberry schnapps and triple sec sweeten the fruit, while 1 oz lemon gives a pronounced sour edge.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.name: Old Fashioned
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.rationale: One sugar cube softens 4.5 cl bourbon; two dashes aromatic bitters provide noticeable bitterness without citrus juice.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.name: Mojito
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.rationale: Two teaspoons sugar temper the juice of one lime, lengthened with soda; lime size and soda volume are unspecified.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1584.name: Mojito Extra
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1584.rationale: 3 cl lemon and eight drops aromatic bitters accompany a large rum/soda pour, with no added sugar listed.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.name: Daiquiri
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.rationale: Only one teaspoon powdered sugar balances half a lime in 1.5 oz rum; expect a tart classic sour.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1138.name: Frozen Daiquiri
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1138.rationale: 1.5 oz lime against a tablespoon triple sec and a teaspoon sugar should stay strongly tart after ice dilution.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1231.name: Strawberry Daiquiri
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1231.rationale: Schnapps, fruit and powdered sugar supply sweetness, with 1 oz lime keeping the frozen mixture tart.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1139.name: Frozen Mint Daiquiri
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1139.rationale: A tablespoon lime and teaspoon sugar in 2 oz rum gives a relatively restrained sweet-sour profile; mint is aromatic, not a bittering dose.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.name: Negroni
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.rationale: Equal parts Campari and sweet vermouth supply sugar, but the full 1 oz Campari makes bitterness dominant; no citrus juice is listed.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1724.name: French Negroni
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1724.rationale: Equal parts Lillet and sweet vermouth create a wine-sweet profile with modest wine acidity; orange peel is aromatic and Campari is absent.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1783.name: Garibaldi Negroni
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1783.rationale: 30 ml Campari supplies strong bitterness, softened by 90 ml orange juice and its sugar/acidity; gin adds no sweetener.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.name: Manhattan
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.rationale: Three-quarter oz sweet vermouth and a cherry soften a bourbon-led pour; a dash aromatic bitters adds a modest bitter finish.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1721.name: Espresso Martini
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1721.rationale: The actual spec lists vodka, only 1 cl Kahlua and a dash syrup, with no espresso: expect modest liqueur sweetness and slight coffee bitterness only.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.name: Moscow Mule
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.rationale: 8 oz ginger ale supplies sugar and dilution, but 2 oz lime is a substantial acidic dose; ginger heat is not rated as bitterness.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.name: Whiskey Sour
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1100.rationale: Half a lemon balanced by only half a teaspoon powdered sugar suggests a tart whiskey sour; garnish contributes little sweetness.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1720.name: Pina Colada
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1720.rationale: This specific spec uses coconut milk rather than sweetened cream of coconut and only three tablespoons pineapple, so sweetness is restrained.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1725.name: Gimlet
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1725.rationale: Equal half-ounce lime and sugar syrup create a balanced sweet-sour accent to 2.5 oz gin; syrup concentration is unspecified.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1219.name: Sidecar
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1219.rationale: 1 oz lemon against 1/2 oz Cointreau gives this cognac-led Sidecar a tart balance; no sugar rim is listed.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1112.name: Boston Sidecar
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1112.rationale: Three-quarter oz triple sec balances half a lime alongside rum and brandy; lime yield is variable.

https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1219.name: Sidecar Cocktail
https://www.thecocktaildb.com/drink/1219.rationale: Half-ounce triple sec against juice of only a quarter lemon gives this smaller brandy Sidecar a sweeter, less tart balance.

demo:leo@shakestir.example:Midnight Velv.name: Midnight Velvet
demo:leo@shakestir.example:Midnight Velv.rationale: 20 ml Kahlua plus 5 ml syrup in 40 ml vodka predicts moderate sweetness and slight coffee-liqueur bitterness; no espresso or citrus juice is listed.

demo:leo@shakestir.example:Ruby Masquera.name: Ruby Masquerade
demo:leo@shakestir.example:Ruby Masquera.rationale: 20 ml triple sec and two ripe strawberries soften 25 ml lime alongside 45 ml tequila, retaining a pronounced sour edge.

demo:leo@shakestir.example:Snowfall Side.name: Snowfall Sidecar
demo:leo@shakestir.example:Snowfall Side.rationale: 20 ml triple sec balances 20 ml lemon with 45 ml cognac; a half sugar rim raises perceived sweetness for rimmed sips.

demo:alex@shakestir.example:My Weekend M.name: My Weekend Margarita
demo:alex@shakestir.example:My Weekend M.rationale: 25 ml lime against 15 ml triple sec in 40 ml tequila is a relatively tart trial spec, consistent with the note to try less lime.

demo:alex@shakestir.example:After Dinner.name: After Dinner Experiment
demo:alex@shakestir.example:After Dinner.rationale: 20 ml Kahlua plus 5 ml syrup against only 30 ml vodka is sweeter than Midnight Velvet; no fresh coffee or citrus is listed.
